items.source: Fetches document and write-locks it for the given duration.
items.translation: 获取文档并在指定时间内对其进行写锁定。

items.source: Note that the client does not enforce an upper limit on the Duration lockTime. The maximum lock time by default on the server is 30 seconds. Any value larger than 30 seconds will be capped down by the server to the default lock time, which is 15 seconds unless modified on the server side.
items.translation: 请注意，客户端不对 Duration 的 lockTime 设置上限。服务器默认的锁定时长最大为 30 秒。任何超过 30 秒的值都会被服务器限制为默认锁定时长，即 15 秒（除非在服务器端进行了修改）。

items.source: withLock in interface WithLock<T>
items.translation: withLock 在接口 WithLock<T> 中

items.source: lockDuration - how long to write-lock the document for (any duration > 30s will be capped to server default of 15s).
items.translation: lockDuration - 文档写锁的持续时间（任何超过 30 秒的时长将被限制为服务器默认的 15 秒）。
克里斯托夫·施特罗布，提格兰·巴博扬
